planets.name: Kepler-438 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-438 with a 35.2-day year, found in 2015.

text.card: Kepler-438 b was found in 2015 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-438. Its orbit and size follow Torres et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.

quotes.title: Kepler-438b
quotes.card: Kepler-438b is a confirmed near-Earth-sized exoplanet.
